look_here_first: LOOK HERE FIRST: Geiser's fleabane is a SMALL annual (5–40 cm) with a SLENDER TAPROOT and generally simple herbaceous base. Basal foliage may have 2–4 pairs of teeth or lobes. Lower stem hairs often spread or bend DOWNWARD while upper hairs are straighter/appressed; fresh white-rayed heads have usually 44–70 rays, 3–6 mm long. It is NOT a perennial woody-crown plant like mature E. modestus. Taproot/hair characters are field-key requirements, not fully proved in existing photos.
